name: Germline (oocyte / spermatogonium)
failures: Age-related oocyte aneuploidy, heritable mutation, infertility.

see.note: Accessible and assessable through assisted reproduction.

model.note: Euploidy is a clear target; the oocyte ageing mechanism is not solved.

reach.note: Ex vivo access is routine in IVF.

edit.note: Technically demonstrated. Heritable human editing is prohibited nearly everywhere — the clearest framework-blocked row on this map.

verify.note: Verification would require following a person across a lifetime, which the prohibition forecloses.

anchors: Heritable genome editing prohibited across most jurisdictions since 2015 consensus
